final_message.text:
Updated `workspace/inventory/pricing.py`, `workspace/inventory/report.py`, and `workspace/inventory/export.py` to match their docstrings: price parsing and half-up discount rounding, strict low-stock filtering with case-insensitive sorting, and RFC 4180 CSV escaping.

I couldn’t run the test suite because Python isn’t available in the environment.
